Packer: rational-angle constructions (fixed-angle LP, enumerator, release) and symmetric-subspace tests (harden --sym-md)

Rational constructions: exact fixed-angle LP with contact forces (fixlp.py), Pythagorean block
enumerator (ratgen.py), angle release (release.py); RG1 / RG2: no records, positive control at
293 reachable only with the right shear + wall placement (~1 in 8,748).  Symmetric subspace:
harden reharden --sym-md 1 (default off); wider record funnels (FW1 179 / 288 vs 41 / 288), but
time travel, blend / duplicate-half symmetrisation and random starts give no records.  Logs:
search/packer/rational/RATIONAL.md, search/packer/symsub/SYMSUB.md.

Packer: side-pinning cores of records vs exact-side alternates (fixlp.mobility, core/coremap.py)

Locked squares (no first-order motion at fixed side) are ~57 % of a record; equal-side alternates move
49 % of all squares but only 16.5 % of locked ones (Jaccard median 0.68).  LP dual cores (~2s squares)
are degenerate, not a fingerprint.  Log: search/packer/core/CORE.md.
